message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && rm -rf /tmp/obj && mkdir -p /tmp/obj && n=0; fail=0; while read f; do
  base=$(basename "$f" .pi)
  out="/tmp/obj/${base}.o"
  if gcc -g -O0 -w -fno-sanitize=all -c "$f" -o "$out" 2>/tmp/err.txt; then
    n=$((n+1))
  else
    fail=$((fail+1))
    echo "FAIL: $f"
    head -3 /tmp/err.txt
  fi
done < /tmp/pi_files.txt
echo "compiled: $n, failed: $fail"
echo "---count obj---"; ls /tmp/obj/*.o | wc -l` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: The compile loop reported 123 compiled but the files aren't there. The issue is the `out` path - the `tr` and `sed` produced a relative path `build_host_src_array.o` which was written relative to cwd, but then... let me re-run the loop more carefully and verify.
